description: Session Management: track active sessions per user, auto-logout based on role (2 hours for tutors/admins, 24 hours for students/parents), UI to view active sessions and revoke them individually or all at once. Syncs with Laravel's database session driver.
steps: 1. Verify SESSION_DRIVER=database in .env (check existing sessions table created in 2024_01_01_000001_create_users_table.php migration). This feature depends on database sessions.

2. Create migration 2026_10_31_000004_create_user_sessions_table.php with Schema::create('user_sessions', ...) containing: id, user_id (FK to users, indexed), session_id (string 255, unique), ip_address (string 45), user_agent (text), last_activity (timestamp), created_at (timestamp only). Foreign key with onDelete('cascade'). Index on (user_id, last_activity) for active session queries.

3. Create model app/Models/UserSession.php with fillable ['user_id','session_id','ip_address','user_agent','last_activity'], timestamps=false (only created_at), casts ['last_activity'=>'datetime','created_at'=>'datetime']. Relationship: belongsTo(User::class). Add scope scopeActive(Builder $query, int $minutes) to filter sessions with last_activity within $minutes.
4. Add relationship to app/Models/User.php: public function userSessions() { return $this->hasMany(UserSession::class); }

5. Create app/Http/Middleware/TrackUserSession.php implementing handle(Request, Closure). Logic: if auth()->check(), get current session ID via session()->getId(), find or create UserSession record for this user+session_id, update last_activity=now(), ip_address, user_agent. Check inactivity timeout based on user role: tutors/admins max 2 hours (120 min), students/parents max 24 hours (1440 min). If last_activity older than threshold, logout user (Auth::logout()), invalidate session, redirect to login with message 'Session expired due to inactivity.' This middleware runs on every authenticated request.
6. Register TrackUserSession middleware in bootstrap/app.php or app/Http/Kernel.php in the 'web' middleware group (after StartSession and Authenticate). Ensure it runs on all authenticated routes.

7. Create app/Services/SessionManagementService.php with methods: getActiveSessions(User $user): Collection (returns user_sessions for this user with last_activity within role-based timeout, ordered by last_activity desc), revokeSession(UserSession $session) (delete UserSession record, find and delete matching session from sessions table by session_id), revokeAllOtherSessions(User $user, string $currentSessionId) (delete all UserSession records for user except current, delete matching sessions from sessions table). Use DB::table('sessions')->where('id', $sessionId)->delete() to remove from sessions table.

8. Create app/Http/Controllers/Settings/SessionController.php with methods: index() [GET /settings/sessions] returns view with active sessions via SessionManagementService::getActiveSessions(auth()->user()), destroy(UserSession $session) [DELETE /settings/sessions/{session}] calls revokeSession() and redirects back with success message, revokeOthers() [POST /settings/sessions/revoke-others] calls revokeAllOtherSessions() with current session ID and redirects back.

9. Add routes to routes/web.php: Route::middleware('auth')->group: GET /settings/sessions (SessionController@index) named 'settings.sessions', DELETE /settings/sessions/{session} (SessionController@destroy) named 'settings.sessions.destroy', POST /settings/sessions/revoke-others (SessionController@revokeOthers) named 'settings.sessions.revoke-others'.

10. Create Blade view resources/views/pages/settings/sessions.blade.php showing table of active sessions. Each row: IP address, Device (parsed user_agent), Last Active (human-readable time ago like '5 minutes ago'), Current Session badge (if session_id matches current), Revoke button (DELETE to /settings/sessions/{session}). Add 'Sign out all other devices' button at top (POST to /settings/sessions/revoke-others with password confirmation modal). Match card-based layout with inline CSS.
11. Integrate sessions section into existing settings page sidebar or tabs. Link from security settings overview. Ensure all user roles can access their session management page.

12. Add cleanup job or command (optional but recommended): php artisan make:command CleanupExpiredSessions. Logic: delete UserSession records where last_activity older than max timeout (24 hours), delete orphaned sessions from sessions table. Schedule in app/Console/Kernel.php to run daily. This is optional; manual cleanup via migration or during login also works.
acceptance_criteria: Every authenticated request creates or updates a user_sessions record with current session_id and timestamp
Tutors and admins are auto-logged out after 2 hours of inactivity (no requests within 2 hours)
Students and parents are auto-logged out after 24 hours of inactivity
Settings page at /settings/sessions shows all active sessions for the current user with IP, device, last active time
Current session is clearly marked with a badge or indicator in the sessions list
Clicking 'Revoke' on a session deletes the user_sessions record and terminates that session (user on that device is logged out)
Clicking 'Sign out all other devices' keeps current session active and terminates all others
Revoking a session requires password confirmation (implement modal or form in the view)
All user roles can manage their own sessions
verification: Run php artisan migrate to create user_sessions table
Login as tutor in browser A, verify user_sessions table has 1 record with session_id matching session()->getId()
Open incognito/another browser, login as same tutor, verify user_sessions now has 2 records with different session_ids
Visit /settings/sessions - verify both sessions appear in the list with correct IP and device info, one marked as 'Current Session'
Click 'Revoke' on the non-current session, verify that session is logged out (test in the other browser)
Login in 3 browsers, click 'Sign out all other devices', verify only current session remains active and other 2 are logged out
Login as tutor, wait 2 hours and 1 minute, make a request - verify auto-logout and redirect to login with 'Session expired' message
Login as student, wait 2 hours and 1 minute, make a request - verify still logged in (24-hour timeout for students)
Wait 24 hours as student, make request - verify auto-logout
Check storage/logs/laravel.log for any errors during session tracking
